questions.stem: C1 = {x : x < 10}, C2 = {x : 10 ≤ x < 20} and C3 = {x : x ≥ 20}. Which set contains the key 20?
questions.explain: The test for C2 needs x < 20, and 20 < 20 is false. The test for C3 needs x ≥ 20, which holds. So 20 is only in C3.

questions.stem: Which of the ages 25, 32, 38, 40, 45 satisfy (age > 30) AND (age < 40)? Give the count.
questions.explain: Both conditions must hold. Only 32 and 38 pass: 25 fails the first, and 40 and 45 fail the second.

questions.stem: A binary search tree has root 50, left child 30 and right child 70. Where is the new key 40 inserted?
questions.explain: 40 < 50, so go left to 30. Then 40 > 30, so go right. That slot is empty, so 40 becomes the right child of 30.

questions.stem: In a tree where every internal node has exactly 3 children and all leaves are at depth 2 (the root is at depth 0), how many leaves are there?
questions.explain: Depth 1 has 3 nodes and depth 2 has 3 × 3 = 9 nodes. All of the depth-2 nodes are leaves.

questions.stem: A binary search tree has root 50, left child 30 and right child 70. What is its inorder traversal (left, node, right)?
questions.explain: Inorder visits the left subtree, then the node, then the right subtree. For a search tree this lists the keys in sorted order.
